error[ZBX-E0101]: can't create a user namespace
  cause  this kernel was built without user namespaces (CONFIG_USER_NS)
  fix    use a kernel built with CONFIG_USER_NS=y
  more   zbx explain E0101 · rerun with --verbose for the full cause chain

error[ZBX-E0103]: cgroup v2 is not set up for this user
  cause  /sys/fs/cgroup/cgroup.controllers exists only on the unified cgroup v2
         hierarchy, so this host runs cgroup v1 or the hybrid layout
  fix    check the mount (cgroup2fs is v2):   stat -fc %T /sys/fs/cgroup
         boot with systemd.unified_cgroup_hierarchy=1, or use a cgroup v2 distro
  more   zbx explain E0103 · rerun with --verbose for the full cause chain

error[ZBX-E0105]: uid and gid mapping is not set up
  cause  uid 1000 (no passwd entry, matched by uid only); no subuid range of
         65536 ids (largest: 0); no subgid range of 65536 ids (largest: 0);
         newuidmap not found; newgidmap not found
  fix    give this user id ranges:    sudo usermod --add-subuids 100000-165535 --add-subgids 100000-165535 $(id -un)
         install on Debian, Ubuntu:   sudo apt install uidmap
         install on Fedora:           sudo dnf install shadow-utils
  more   zbx explain E0105 · rerun with --verbose for the full cause chain

error[ZBX-E0106]: seccomp is not available
  cause  the seccomp check could not run: read(/proc/self/status) failed: no
         such file or directory (ENOENT)
  fix    check the file, then retry:   ls -l /proc/self/status
  more   zbx explain E0106 · rerun with --verbose for the full cause chain
